answer: Identity begins at a juniper ring: slow-growing hardware enrollment where each agent burns one unique silicon key, so a thousand fakes demand a thousand real dies from a queue months deep. Every enrollee then crosses a bridge, a signed-quote gateway that holds a forfeitable bond before any credit line opens. Finally a mirror pass replays all registrations against the chain, so two agents quoting one chip are both cancelled and both bonds burn. The attacker pays N dies plus N forfeited bonds rather than N keypairs.
